about: The routing block a product's forge integration carries (PATCH /api/teams/{id}/forge/repo-bots/{integration_id}, `routing`) so that every LLM site of the shipped Revi pair runs on claw against the team's own PLIAGE gateway model, with the reasoning effort of each node decided by its cell (#3283, D2). The node ids are the ROLE names of ADR-169 (`reviewer`, `reviewer_alternate`, `reviewer_glance`, `converge`): an integration pinned before that rename carries the retired ids and must be migrated (#2699).

The cells without `effort` are the activation block of 2026-11-10, as 17 integrations carried it on 2026-11-15 (read-only GET, the same block on all 17). Each `effort` is a level the platform's `pliage` feed accepts for the cell's model (testdata/pliage_declared_entries.json), so the route sends it as asked and emits no reasoning_effort_adjusted (ADR-166 section 7 keeps ties going up, D3).
`effort` sits on node cells only: a `#glm` route runs at its node's effort and a supervisor names a model only, so llmroute.Validate refuses the field on both.
scripts/ops/revi-effort-cells.py applies the `effort` fields of this block, and nothing else, to each integration's stored block.

effort_rationale.revi-converse/converse_agent: high (D4). The node's own dial asks `medium`, which the feed does not list, so every converse step already ran at `high` (reasoning_effort_adjusted, source feed:pliage). The cell names the level the run gets.
effort_rationale.review-pr/reviewer_alternate: high (plan section 2). The alternate reviewer — the claude slot, run only by a `paired` launch — keeps high. Its dial reads `max` on the platform (bot-vars ITERION_VIBE_EFFORT_CLAUDE, set 2026-11-04): on 2026-11-13 the node then named reviewer_claude sent `max`, 86-92% of its output thinking. The cell fixes high whatever the dial reads.
effort_rationale.review-pr/reviewer: high (plan section 2), as reviewer_alternate: the primary reviewer.
effort_rationale.review-pr/reviewer_glance: low (plan section 2, chosen explicitly). F15: `low` is the lowest level the feed lists for deepseek-v4.1-flash, so effortAfterCut (pkg/backend/model/structured_recovery.go) has nothing to lower to: a final turn cut at max_tokens, or a recovery pass that failed, gets no retry at a reduced effort on this node. Accepted for the cheap tier: in the M1 runs (2026-11-15) and their baselines, no step of a celled node finished on length or max_tokens, and the largest output of a glance was 7457 tokens, 23% of the 32768 the feed allows. M2a counts the cut final passes and the node goes back to high if they appear.
effort_rationale.review-pr/converge: low (plan section 2, chosen explicitly). The merge step reads two structured outputs; F15 as for the glance: below low there is no reduced-effort retry. In the M1 runs and their baselines the merge's largest output at high was 2501 tokens, with no cut step. Since review-pr 0.9.25 the node declares its tool surface (#3283 S9), so the claw route this cell pins merges whole — report and board issues included, where the pre-S9 dispatch wrote nothing. M2a counts the cut final passes; back to high if they appear. One node serves both topologies now (ADR-169): the retired `converge_gpt` cell and this one were identical, and `converge#glm` has no subject — the node runs on claw, which reads no GLM rescue.
